title: ONSure Observation Record v1
description: A single datapoint produced by a Collector during an execution, referencing the CollectorHealthRecord (collector-health-record.v1.schema.json) that attests the Collector's state at observation time. authoritative=true asserts this observation may be used as evidence for a positive claim; whether that assertion is actually permitted (the referenced CollectorHealthRecord must be HEALTHY+QUALIFIED+FULL) is a cross-contract invariant, not expressible inside this schema alone -- enforced by tests/test_wave2_execution_evidence.py.

authoritative.description: true asserts this observation is usable as evidence for a positive claim. A stale/unqualified/degraded/failed Collector must never produce authoritative=true (cross-contract invariant).
